_comment: Copy to deployments/<name>/deployment.json (git-ignored) and replace every <placeholder>. Nothing here ships in the app or the server bundle; tests/no-owner-data.test.ts reads this file from each local deployment and checks that no committed app or server file names these values. Apply the vars once with: npx wrangler deploy --var POLICY_AUD:<aud> --var TEAM_DOMAIN:<team> --var DOMAINS:<domains> (keep_vars keeps them afterwards).

cloudflareToken.issuedBy: <how the token was issued: a dashboard template or your secret store>
cloudflareToken.label: <the token's name in the Cloudflare dashboard>
